name: Simple Mock Server (atkinsonbg)
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed Docker-based HTTP API mock server with no software-enforced usage quota or expiry. Load JSON mock definitions from a mounted /api/Mocks directory; match request URL, method, body and headers and return configured responses.
watch_out: Self-hosted software only: Docker host, network and storage are not provided for free. The project is intentionally minimal: no recording, replay, sharing or management UI. README demonstrates Docker image atkinsonbg/mock-server:0.1 on port 5000; verify image availability and maintenance before production use. Avoid publicly exposing test routes or sensitive mock payloads.
